Metadata.title: Pisa
Metadata.description: A reality check for viral videos: is what you see physically possible?

Home.tagline: AI can fake pixels. It can't fake physics.
Home.lede: Send a video of something falling, thrown or bouncing. Pisa measures its motion and tells you whether real gravity could have produced it.

Check.title: Check a video
Check.scope: Pisa checks falls, throws and bounces. It does not check face swaps, lip-sync or cloned voices.
